mines.mine_notes: 25% interest in the Schaft Creek Joint Venture (Teck Resources 75%, operator), a large porphyry copper-gold-molybdenum-silver project in the Golden Triangle / Tahltan Territory, NW BC. 2013 FS (100% basis): 130,000 tpd open pit; capex US$3.256B; 21-year mine life. P&P reserves (2013 FS): 940.8 Mt @ 0.27% Cu, 0.0176% Mo, 0.19 g/t Au, 1.72 g/t Ag = 5.6 Blb Cu, 5.7 Moz Au, 363.5 Mlb Mo, 51.7 Moz Ag. 2021 PEA evaluated a 133,000 tpd case on M+I resources of 1,345.5 Mt @ 0.26% Cu, 0.16 g/t Au, 0.017% Mo, 1.25 g/t Ag. JV considering transition to PFS stage; 2025 budget C$15.8M (C$15.3M spent); five-hole 2025 drill program south of Liard zone hit copper-gold mineralization. JV terms: Teck funds first $60M pre-production (done; +$30M above), Copper Fox 25% costs offset against two remaining $20M milestone payments; Teck may loan the 25% share beyond $220M cumulative. Teck/Anglo American merger approved Dec 2025.

notes: Ticker CUU on TSX-V; OTCQX: CPFXF; Frankfurt: HPU. FY2025 = year ended October 31, 2025 (MD&A dated Feb 4, 2026). Aug 21, 2023; QP Sue Bird, Moose Mountain; C$5.50 NSR cutoff, pit-constrained): Indicated 70.81 Mt @ 0.221% Cu, 0.0108% Mo, 0.061 g/t Au, 0.9 g/t Ag (0.326% CuEq; 345 Mlb Cu, 16.9 Mlb Mo, 139.6 koz Au, 2,151 koz Ag in situ); Inferred 242.33 Mt @ 0.192% Cu, 0.0035% Mo, 0.043 g/t Au, 0.6 g/t Ag (0.246% CuEq; 1,025 Mlb Cu, 18.7 Mlb Mo, 335.8 koz Au, 4,971 koz Ag in situ). Also holds Arizona ISCR projects. President/CEO: Elmer B. Stewart. Attributable Schaft Creek reserves shown at 25% (235.2 Mt; 1.4 Blb Cu, 1.425 Moz Au, 12.9 Moz Ag, 90.9 Mlb Mo).
